title: Decoupled CMS: Razor Pages With Orchard Core Content | Orchard Core
description:
A website often needs its own front end, with its own routes and markup, while editors still manage the content without touching code.

In a decoupled site, Orchard Core runs the administration and stores the content, and your Razor Pages load content items and render them. This video builds one from a Razor Pages project: a blog post that editors create, a readable address based on an alias, and a preview that uses your own page.

In this video:
• What decoupled means
• Add Orchard Core to a Razor Pages project
• Set up the site with the Blank site recipe
• Model a blog post with a content type
• Create a blog post in the administration
• Render it in a Razor Page by its identifier
• Friendly addresses with the Alias part
• Preview your edits with your own page
• Summary
